entities.summary: Pamela Cecile Rasmussen is an American ornithologist and expert on Asian birds. She was formerly a research associate at the Smithsonian Institution in Washington, D.C., and is based at the Michigan State University. She is associated with other major centers of research in the United States and the United Kingdom. Pamela C. Rasmussen was a writers & intellectuals from United States (b. 1959-10-16).
